messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed some hovercards in the per-model cost panel showing negative "cache savings" after we switched a few tenants to sampled telemetry. example: model=redwood-3b route=/summarize sample_rate=0.002 showed -$0.07
rajiv: low-N noise + warmup amortization interaction. prefetched hits rare -> amortized warmup can dominate and flip sign
ben: agreed. console currently expects a point-estimate from /telemetry/cost/hover. We need richer payload: sample_count, ci, source (live|rollup|suppressed)
tessa: UX options: 1) hide savings if n < N, 2) show CI and n, 3) fallback to daily rollup for low n. prefer (2)+rollup fallback with clear badge
sophie: also consider quota effects — if tenant is throttled sample_count is misleading. show a small banner: "quota may limit samples" when throttle_rate > 0.2
maria: proposal: backend v2 returns {estimate, sample_count, ci_low, ci_high, source, method, advisory_message} plus header `X-Rollup-Used` when rollup chosen
ben: backend plan: analytic CI via delta-method for common routes, bootstrap precomputed in daily rollup for high-variance ones. choose source by thresholds: LIVE_N=100, ROLLUP_MIN=30 configurable per org
rajiv: add feature-flagged query param `force_live_estimate=true` (audited) for debuggers. console should show a CTA: "low samples  view 7d rollup"
tessa: console: render thin translucent CI band under estimate, show "n=XX" and a help link "why this is noisy". if source==rollup show clock icon + tooltip about 24h lag
ben: I'll open PR feat/hover-sampling-v2 with API shape and default thresholds. will include header `X-Sample-Window: 7d`
maria: pls link PR here when ready. i want to test against tenant that filed the ticket
deploy-bot: deploybot: queued canary deploy of telemetry-hover-v2 in 8m :rocket:
ben: thanks — will smoke test canary and post payload examples
maria: cheers, team. good UX choices will stop support noise :raised_hands:
